name: invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible
statement: Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible (fromBlocks A B 0 D)] : Invertible A × Invertible D where fst

name: invertibleOfFromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible
statement: Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible (fromBlocks A 0 C D)] : Invertible A × Invertible D where fst

name: inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff
statement: Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α) (hAD : IsUnit A ↔ IsUnit D) : (fromBlocks A B 0 D)⁻¹ = fromBlocks A⁻¹ (-(A⁻¹ * B * D⁻¹)) 0 D⁻¹

name: inv_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_of_isUnit_iff
statement: Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) (hAD : IsUnit A ↔ IsUnit D) : (fromBlocks A 0 C D)⁻¹ = fromBlocks A⁻¹ 0 (-(D⁻¹ * C * A⁻¹)) D⁻¹
